title: 擠壓性地層讓壓支護
summary: 本課以把擠壓地層收斂、讓壓行程與支護時序連成設計模型為主線，從應力強度比與初篩與收斂拘束與交會點建立系統邊界，再把收斂速率與時效、噴層間隙與局部壓碎連到觀察法與調整證據。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on link squeezing-ground convergence, yielding travel and support timing. It begins with Stress-strength ratio and screening and Convergence-confinement intersection, links Convergence rate and time dependence and Shotcrete slots and local crushing, and ends with Observational design and adjustment evidence. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查應力強度比與初篩：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33；再獨立檢查收斂拘束與交會點：supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa。覆土由 500 增為 600 m、單位重 26 kN/m3，垂直應力由 13 增為 15.6 MPa；對 3 MPa 岩體強度的比由 4.33 變為 5.2，只作初篩。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 將用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Stress-strength ratio and screening: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33. Independently check Convergence-confinement intersection: supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa. At 26 kN/m3, cover rising from 500 to 600 m raises vertical stress from 13 to 15.6 MPa and its ratio to 3 MPa rock-mass strength from 4.33 to 5.2, for screening only. The two results are not a complete design because squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. Use test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應力強度比與初篩」與「收斂拘束與交會點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stress-strength ratio and screening" and "Convergence-confinement intersection": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力強度比與初篩」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stress-strength ratio and screening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高覆土應力與低岩體強度的組合可能造成大變形，但垂直應力不代表完整三維應力場。完整岩樣強度也不同於節理岩體強度，將兩者混用會高估地層能力；比值只協助比較調查情境，不能單獨決定讓壓構件和開挖尺寸。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示；若出現把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力強度比與初篩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High cover stress combined with weak rock mass can produce large deformation, but vertical stress is not the full three-dimensional field. Intact-sample strength differs from jointed-rock strength. The ratio helps compare investigation scenarios but cannot alone determine yielding components or excavation geometry. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. If using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stress-strength ratio and screening” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應力強度比與初篩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stress-strength ratio and screening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

options: 應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應力強度比與初篩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stress-strength ratio and screening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「應力強度比與初篩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stress-strength ratio and screening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「應力強度比與初篩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stress-strength ratio and screening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「讓壓平台與行程需求」與「預留變形與淨空消耗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 讓壓平台與行程需求：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「讓壓平台與行程需求」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Yielding plateau and travel demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 讓壓元件在變形中維持反力，目的是避免剛性支護過早超載，同時保留必要拘束。平台力太低可能無法穩住地層，行程太短則很快轉為高剛度；需把力、行程與地層預期收斂一起比較，不能只選最大吸能值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變；若出現讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「讓壓平台與行程需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A yielding element maintains restraint while deforming to avoid premature overload of rigid support. Too little force may not stabilize ground; too little travel quickly returns to high stiffness. Compare force and stroke against expected convergence rather than selecting the largest energy rating alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end. If exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Yielding plateau and travel demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 讓壓平台與行程需求：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「讓壓平台與行程需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Yielding plateau and travel demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 讓壓平台與行程需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Yielding plateau and travel demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「讓壓平台與行程需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Yielding plateau and travel demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 收斂速率與時效：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 擠壓地層可能在掌子面遠離後繼續變形，速率曲線有助區分短期卸載和持續蠕變。不同量測間隔會把尖峰平均掉，施工停頓也改變時間基準；比較需同時保留距面距離和真實經過時間，不應只按進尺排序。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用固定時間尺度與距面位置共同比較收斂速率；若出現長停機期間的變形被漏記，使後續支護需求低估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂速率與時效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Squeezing can continue after the face has moved away, and rates help distinguish immediate unloading from continuing creep. Sampling intervals average peaks, while stoppages change elapsed time. Preserve both distance from the face and real time rather than ordering observations solely by advance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare convergence rates on consistent time intervals and face-relative positions. steps.title: 拱架滑移接頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sliding joints in steel ribs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱架滑移接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sliding joints in steel ribs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐接頭量測滑移、夾緊狀態與拱架輪廓變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure slip and clamping at every joint together with rib-profile change to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If one jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個接頭名義行程相加就是任何方向可用收斂」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding nominal joint strokes gives available convergence in every direction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instructionEn: Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. Incompatible infill can lock them early. Slot closure is not uniform lining strain because adjacent shotcrete still bends and contacts ground; track it alongside steel-rib sliding rather than as an isolated gap. If accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「長期荷載與二次襯砌」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term load and secondary lining” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 二次襯砌完成後地層仍可能蠕變，初支和永久結構的分擔取決於接觸、剛度與施工時間。不能因外觀停止變形就假定永久荷載不再增加，儀器解析度也可能掩蓋慢速變化；設計應保留長期監測和可解釋的力學模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢；若出現短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期荷載與二次襯砌」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground may creep after secondary lining, with load sharing governed by contact, stiffness and timing. Apparently stopped movement does not prove constant permanent demand, and resolution can hide slow trends. Preserve long-term monitoring and an interpretable mechanical model for later comparisons. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-term load and secondary lining” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長期荷載與二次襯砌」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long-term load and secondary lining”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
